run_inference: run inference on a benchmark system with optional warmup and timed iterations to measure QPS and GPU memory
compare_results: compare candidate inference predictions against a baseline result and compute energy and force error metrics
format_report_table: format benchmark results dictionary as a human-readable table with energy error, force MAE, QPS, and GPU memory columns
PerfCheckRunner: run a benchmark that compares an inference configuration against an fp64 baseline across multiple systems and saves a JSON report
InferenceResult: create an InferenceResult dataclass to store energy, forces, stress, QPS, wall time, and peak GPU memory from inference
